turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
Here is the rule: put always, usually, sometimes or never before the action word, but after am, is or are.
Right: "Owls usually hunt at night."
Wrong: "Owls hunt usually at night." Usually comes after the action word hunt, so it is in the wrong place.
My example: "The zoo is always busy." There is no action word, so always goes after is.
Now your turn. Put the words in order:
"usually / my cousin / walks / to school"
